name: hoistables
description: Tested hoistables: install and run real apps. Each app is its own plugin, so a self-hosted one never collides.

plugins.name: agent-dyno
plugins.description: Set up and run agent-dyno on this machine, then self-test it and report honestly what worked. Ships as a recipe: on first use it fetches a verified toolchain, brings agent-dyno up in a sandbox, and grades it.
